toasts.passwordGenerated: New password generated — copy it now

sessions.description: Active sign-ins for this account. Revoke other devices here; sign out of this device from the user menu.
sessions.revokeDescription: That device will be signed out. You will stay signed in here.
sessions.revokeOthersDescription: Every other active sign-in will end. This device stays signed in.

errors.revokeNotFound: That session is no longer active. The list was refreshed.

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: View Places on a public street map, inspect sourced news, and load data from saved Sources.
maps.emptyPins: Nothing is pinned yet. Load data from an enabled Source to place active Places on the map.

create.needLocation: Create a Location first, then add a Place here.
create.emptyHint: Click the map to add a Location (a building or site). Add Places from that Location, or load data from an enabled Source.
create.locationHint: A building or site. Add shops and units after this.

maps.emptyFilter: No active Places match these filters.

locate.unsupported: This browser cannot read the current location.
locate.failed: Could not read the current location.
locate.denied: Location permission was denied. Allow location for this site, then try again.
locate.timeout: Reading the current location timed out. Try again.
locate.insecure: The browser blocks current location on this HTTP origin. Use HTTPS, or allow this origin as a secure origin in the browser.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Reusable sites (buildings). A Location can host many Places.
locations.addPlaceHint: A Location is the site. Add a Place for each shop or unit here.

places.title: Places
places.description: Shops and units pinned at a Location.
places.deleteDescription: Remove {{name}}? News for this Place is deleted.

filters.title: Filters
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search places, locations, or an address…

search.empty: No matching places, locations, or addresses.

detail.title: Place detail
detail.emptyNews: No news yet for this Place.
detail.statusHint: Operators can set active or hidden. Pending is reserved for Places without valid coordinates.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Saved HTTP endpoints used by Load data. Only enabled Sources are fetched.
sources.createDescription: Save a structured-list endpoint and map its fields onto the fixed schema.
sources.editDescription: Update this Source. Later Load data uses the saved values only.
sources.emptyDescription: Create a Source to ingest a structured list into Places.
sources.deleteDescription: Remove {{name}}? Existing Places and news stay. This Source will not be fetched again.
sources.readOnlyHint: You can view Sources but cannot change them.

fields.name: Name
fields.enabledHint: Load data fetches only enabled saved Sources.
fields.urlHint: Absolute http:// or https:// URL. The API fetches this from the backend, so use a host the backend can reach (Docker sample: http://fe:3000/maps-sample-feed.json). Unsaved URLs are never fetched.
fields.bodyHint: JSON request body for POST, PUT, or PATCH.
fields.listPathHint: Dot path from the JSON root to the item array. Leave empty if the root is the array.
fields.categoryMapHint: JSON object mapping source category strings to catalog keys (roomRental, restaurant, hotel, eatery, uncategorized).
fields.mappingPathHint: Dot path on each list item. Leave empty to skip this field.
fields.noHeaders: No headers yet. Add one only if the endpoint requires it.
fields.noParams: No query parameters yet. Add one only if the endpoint requires it.

wizard.description: Connect the API, pick the list path, then map fields onto the fixed schema.
wizard.connectHint: Enter the endpoint. The backend will call it and discover fields from the JSON response.
wizard.pathHint: {{count}} fields found on the first list item.
wizard.saveHint: Save this Source. Load data will fetch only the saved, enabled URL.
wizard.probeFailed: Could not load a JSON list from that URL
wizard.needProbe: Test the connection first so the wizard can read the response.
wizard.needList: That path is not a JSON array. Use a path like data.items, or leave it empty if the root is the array.
wizard.noPreview: No response yet. Go back and test the connection, or continue if you already know the mapping.
wizard.noFields: No fields on the first item. Check the list path.

ingest.inProgress: Load data is running. Pins will refresh when this run finishes.
ingest.conflict: Another Load data run is already in progress.
